gaps.explanation: Statement lines = Total Proprietary Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Fund (p11, printed p15): Charges for services 4,443,231 + Sales taxes 443,665 + Miscellaneous 102,118 + Interest and investment revenue 48,566 + Insurance claims reimbursements 88,394 = 5,125,974. Detail = the Enterprise Fund Accounts - ACCRUAL BASIS combining schedule (pp15-16, printed pp52-53), Light / Water / Sewer / Sanitation / Others columns: Charges for services 4,447,596 + Sales taxes 446,180 + Miscellaneous 102,118 + Interest and investment revenue 47,166 + Insurance property proceeds 88,394 = 5,131,454 (every printed non-blank cell is in detail once). The two statements are on different bases: accrual charges 4,447,596 vs modified cash 4,443,231 (+4,365), sales taxes 446,180 vs 443,665 (+2,515); the p11 Enterprise Fund column covers the same money as the combining schedule, so its cells are not added (double count). The remaining part of the statement total is the p11 Internal Service Fund column: Interest and investment revenue 1,400 (statement 48,566 = Enterprise 47,166 + Internal Service 1,400) and Transfers in (out) 80,000 (counterpart of the enterprise net transfers out (80,000) already in detail: Light (1,434,603), Water 164,673, Sewer 620,735, Others 569,195). These are internal service fund cells, which the rules exclude from the utility detail, so they are not added; the JSON statement receipts include the 1,400 because they come from the Total Proprietary Funds column. Gap -5,480 = 4,365 + 2,515 (basis) - 1,400 (internal service fund interest in the statement total).

Statement (p11-12, Total Proprietary Funds, modified cash): Total operating expenses 4,255,435 + Employee benefit claim payments 101,423 + Bond issuance costs and trustee fees 40,517 + Interest expense 48,151 = 4,445,526. Detail (accrual combining schedule pp15-16): Total operating expenses 4,251,099 + Interest expense 48,151 + Bond issuance costs and trustee fee 40,517 + Employee benefit claims (net) 66,220 = 4,405,987. Gap 39,539 = operating expenses 4,255,435 - 4,251,099 = 4,336 (e.g. Salaries 627,426 vs 625,888, Health insurance 272,737 vs 262,453, Insurance 95,560 vs 89,010, Plant repairs 421,486 vs 426,243, Utilities 56,785 vs 61,214) + employee benefit claims 101,423 (cash, gross) - 66,220 (accrual, net) = 35,203. 4,336 + 35,203 = 39,539. The Internal Service Fund column prints no expenses. All combining-schedule cells are in detail once; the p11 Enterprise column is the same money on the other basis and is not added. No governmental other-financing row is missing: p8 Loan proceeds General 110,000 and Street Repair and Maintenance 165,000 are in detail; the governmental statement prints no transfers.
